tei:div.tei:p: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rtsa gsum spyi'i dkar gtor 'dod dgu kun 'byung bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: gsang sngags lam 'jug skyes bu yis: gegs sel sngon du 'gro ba'i thabs: dkar gtor 'dod dgu kun 'byung bstan: gtor ma skyems bcas legs bshams nas: nam mkha' mdzod kyis byin brlabs la: hūm̐: mchod sbyin gtor ma ro brgya nus pa ldan: gtsang sbyar gser skyems dkar gsum phun tshogs 'di: ting nge 'dzin gyis rab tu spel ba yi: so sor 'dod pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i: lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs dang: gza' rgyal bdud btsan the rang sogs: srin po dri za yid gzugs 'chang: thams cad kun la mchod gtor sbyin: tshims par gyis la bdag cag gi: byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod la: ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par: sdong grogs dam pa mdzad du gsol: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' dam bzhin: phrin las dam pa myur 'grub mdzod: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ces gtor ma skyems dang bcas pa mchod: ces su kha badz+ra gyi brdzun ris so// 266) spyi gces sngon 'gro'i 'jug sgo zab mo bzhugs: rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam rnams kyis rdor dril snying gar gsor zhing: rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gsal la: hūm̐ dzñā na badz+ra hrīḥ hūm̐ dzñā na badz+ra mūm̐: brjod nas dkrol te: rang dam tshig lha'i thugs srog sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi bla ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar dpag tu med pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rol mo dkrol nas: hūm̐: sngon gyi= dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hring hring dza dzaḥ bsang chu byin brlabs ni:

oṃ swa bha wa= stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bsang chu'i steng du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bgegs rnams 'joms pa'i rang bzhin can du bsams te: oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta krit+ta hūm̐ phaṭa: bdun nam nyer gcig brjod: slar yang khro bo 'od du zhu nas chu dang 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mi gtsang ba'i dri ma 'joms pa'i rang bzhin du 267)gyur: a mṛ ta sa bsangs: oṃ swa bha wa sogs: stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod: yangs shing rgya che'i nang du ni: 'dod yon phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas: kun bzang mchod sprin bla na med: bde gshegs rgyal kun dgyes pa'i rdzas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs: shap+da ma hā gu h+ya sarba pū dza ho āḥhūm̐: rol mo bcas byin brlab bya: sa ma ya: zhes pa bha dra'i ming gis bris pa'o: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig na ra kan kha thaṃ: dge'o// chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rtsa gsum spyi gces mchod rdzas byin rlabs bsdus pa bzhugs: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas bsam mi khyab: kun bzang nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du: rab 'byams rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs: shap+da sarba pū dza ho: ma hā sarba pū dza a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta bho dhi tsit+ta gu h+ya pū dza āḥhūm̐: ces bde ba'i rdo rjes so// 268) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi cha lag mtshams lha bskyed pa ni: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha h+ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: rang nyid skad cig gis gzhi lus dpal rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dbyug to dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs pa dbu skra dmar ser srid rtser 'khyil zhing sku la khro chas yongs su rdzogs pa pad nyi bam gyi gdan la 'gying stabs su bzhugs shing ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du bskyed do:

de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas dbyings nas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la bstim mo: hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes rol pa drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas: bgegs 'dul khro bo'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na: gdon bgegs 'byung po 'gugs bskrad las mdzod cig: oṃ ṭā ki ra dza hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ bam hoḥ aṃ ku sha ya hūm̐: zhes dang: oṃ swa bha wa= sogs: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las trām̐ las rin po che'i snod du bgegs kyi gtor ma 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha hoḥ 269)hrīḥ oṃ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ 'gugs rgya bcas lan gsum: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: gis byin brlabs la gzhung du 'jug: ces pa 'di yang dge btsun dam pa 'gya los dar bcas bskul ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// ༈ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: gnam phud bdud rtsi kun khyab bzhugs so: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du: gnam phud bdud rtsi kun khyab bstan: dkar dmar tshogs rdzas bdud rtsir brlabs: lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes dbyings dang dbyings bzhugs pa'i: brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma dang: rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha: gnas yul dur khrod la gnas pa'i: dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro ma: sha za shugs 'gro la sogs dang: bka' srung pho rgyud mo rgyud tshogs: bstan srung dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: gnas 'dir gshegs la tshogs mchod rol: 'dod yon rgyan gyi tshogs= dam rdzas rgyan gyi tshogs= sha khrag dmar gyi tshogs= bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: gdod ma'i gzhi ru 270)grol bar mdzod: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma ya: phrin las rab 'byams myur 'grub mdzod: dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: zhes brjod skyems gtor gtsang sar mchod:
gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa dang: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang bde ba'i rdo rjes 'khrul nyams yig gzugs su bkod pa'o//
